question: which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5

which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH matched_children AS (
  SELECT
    b."Child ID",
    b."Child Name",
    b."Gender",
    b."Age",
    b."Location",
    b."Coach",
    b."Shuttle Run sec",
    b."Sit Ups" AS baseline_sit_ups,
    e."Sit Ups" AS endline_sit_ups,
    NULLIF(e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups", 0) AS situp_jump
  FROM
    sportathon_baseline b
  LEFT JOIN
    sportathon_endline e
    ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) >= 0.9
    AND b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."Child ID" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) DESC) = 1
  WHERE
    b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
    AND e."Child ID" IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_jumps AS (
  SELECT
    "Child ID",
    "Child Name",
    "Gender",
    "Age",
    "Location",
    "Coach",
    baseline_sit_ups,
    endline_sit_ups,
    situp_jump,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY situp_jump DESC) AS jump_rank
  FROM
    matched_children
  WHERE
    situp_jump IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  "Child ID",
  "Child Name",
  "Gender",
  "Age",
  "Location",
  "Coach",
  baseline_sit_ups,
  endline_sit_ups,
  situp_jump
FROM
  ranked_jumps
WHERE
  jump_rank <= 5
ORDER BY
  situp_jump DESC;
```
